headline: Marcos Leads National Heroes Day Rites at Libingan ng mga Bayani
seoTitle: National Heroes Day 2026: Marcos Leads Rites | FMB News
seoDescription: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. led National Heroes Day rites at the Libingan ng mga Bayani and urged Filipinos to carry forward the country's tradition of service.
deck: The President honored historical and modern-day heroes and called for continued service, patriotism and defense of Philippine sovereignty.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. led the National Heroes Day commemoration on August 31 at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in the Libingan ng mga Bayani in Taguig City.
Government officials, military and uniformed personnel, scouts, civil servants and members of the public joined the ceremony.

sections.heading: The President's message
paragraphs: Marcos called on Filipinos to honor the country's heroes by continuing their tradition of service and patriotism, and cited workers, responders, teachers, health personnel, farmers, fisherfolk and overseas Filipinos among today's everyday heroes.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: National Heroes Day is observed on the last Monday of August and honors Filipinos who contributed to the country's freedom and nation-building.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The annual commemoration connects historical remembrance with current civic responsibility, including public service and protection of national sovereignty.
